name: Start Here
author: Multiverse Video editors
description: Ten accessible videos, each with one concrete next action.

items.note: Framasoft's short, translated explainer of the Fediverse: many independent servers that talk to each other, like email.
A clear introduction to housing co-ops: how residents own and run their buildings together, and why it keeps rents down.
Framasoft's two-minute explainer of PeerTube, the federated video platform this app reads from, with subtitles in 30+ languages.
Three minutes presenting DAIR's report on Amazon delivery drivers: how workplace surveillance tech is used to cut pay and hide responsibility.
A plain-language walkthrough of threat modeling: who might want your data, what they could do with it, and which protections are worth your effort.
The story of B4RN, a community-built fibre network in rural England that has connected over 7,000 homes through joint action, with captions.
Artist bleeptrack's workshop on coding your own generative art with paper.js, from first shape to a piece that surprises you.
Two minutes from unboxing to running code: installing MicroPython on a tiny ESP32-C3 board.
Veronica Explains pushes back on tech's habit of shaming people's hardware and software choices: your tools are probably fine.
Five concrete email-security rules from a digital-security hotline expert, framed around the phishing campaigns that target journalists and activists.
